summary: MacBook Pro (office) is the main computer. Smartphone and MacBook Air are remote command surfaces only. pipeline_data stays on Mac local — no full Git sync.

architecture.data_store: Mac local pipeline_data (naver_drafts, assets, oauth, sqlite, chrome profiles)
architecture.git_scope: scripts, .cursor/rules, small jarvis_memory JSON, audiso-global site code

execution_path: Cloud command → My Machines worker (macbook-pro-audiso) → Mac local → episode result back to Cloud
